Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::renewBook(uid: String,barcode: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		user: User = User.allInstance()->any(u|u.UserID = uid),
		loan: Loan = Loan.allInstance()->any(l|l.LoanedCopy.Barcode = barcode and
		l.LoanedUser = user and
		l.IsReturned = false)
	precondition:
		user.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		loan.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		loan.IsReturned = false
	postcondition:
		loan.RenewedTimes = loan.RenewedTimes+1 and
		loan.RenewDate = loan.DueDate and
		loan.DueDate = loan.DueDate+PredefinedRenewPeriod and
		result = true
}
